name: harness
description: Reusable Codex harness for workflow-oriented project task control and adapter-driven execution. / 可复用 Codex 项目任务控制与 adapter 执行工作流。

interface.shortDescription: Orient, intake, initialize, and execute adapter-driven project work. / 定位、收集、初始化并执行 adapter 驱动的项目工作。
interface.longDescription: Agent Harness uses one model-neutral baseline with optional host runtime Goal, Plan, Thread, and subagent capabilities, plus durable fixed/adapter project control: authoritative Task/Goal state, repository Runs/DAGs, postflight state sync, gates, and evidence. zh-CN fallback: Agent Harness 使用兼容不同模型的基础协议，并在 host 暴露能力时使用 runtime Goal、Plan、Thread 和 subagent，连接到持久化 fixed / adapter 项目控制，包括权威 Task/Goal 状态、repository Run/DAG、postflight 状态同步、gate 和 evidence。
defaultPrompt: Use harness:orient to inspect durable state and choose codex-direct, codex-direct-postflight, or durable-harness. Use native runtime Goal and Plan only when the current host exposes them; otherwise use the current thread and a short checklist.
